name: Oxymorphazone
summary: Oxymorphazone is an opioid analgesic drug related to oxymorphone. Oxymorphazone is a potent and long acting μ-opioid agonist which binds irreversibly to the receptor, forming a covalent bond which prevents it from detaching once bound.

pharmacology.text: Oxymorphazone is a potent and long acting μ-opioid agonist which binds irreversibly to the receptor, forming a covalent bond which prevents it from detaching once bound.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study opioid receptors. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是用於研究鴉片受體的化合物，並非藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是用于研究鸦片受体的化合物，并非药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Because its binding cannot be undone, naloxone would be of little help.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。由於它的結合無法解除，納洛酮幾乎起不了作用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。由于它的结合无法解除，纳洛酮几乎起不了作用。

fact.en: It locks on to the opioid receptor for good, forming a permanent chemical bond, so the receptor stays switched on until the cell replaces it.
fact.zh: 它會永久地鎖在鴉片受體上，形成不可逆的化學鍵，使受體一直處於開啟狀態，直到細胞自行更換受體。
fact.zhHans: 它会永久地锁在鸦片受体上，形成不可逆的化学键，使受体一直处于打开状态，直到细胞自行更换受体。
